methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Replace only PR1668 kernel_ok by support-index sums on its bounded binary incidence rows; prove exact predicate equivalence, enumerate removed scalar products and measure the complete unchanged replay.
scope_change_reason: One isolated source-bound replay and one measured kernel-product bottleneck; this is implementation work rather than an audit or a new proof of the predecessor result.
bottleneck_link: The adapter lowers the cost of an entire exact frame-incidence replay without changing any mathematical check. It supplies no supplier or kappa improvement.
stop_rule: Stop at the first complete output-equivalent speed improvement. Do not optimize ranks, geometry, frame enumeration, fixtures or controls.
evidence: README.md proves the sparse integer predicate. verify.py compares every one of 148 reached kernel calls, the complete scientific stdout, 55987 small dot products and source/domain controls. benchmark.py times alternating fresh complete processes.
